items.title: Demo first-level appeal
items.body: FICTIONAL DEMO POLICY. First-level appeals may be prepared within 180 calendar days of the denial notice. This sample is for product demonstration only.
items.source: Fictional ClaimCoach video fixture; not an insurer policy

items.title: Demo authorization-denial documentation
items.body: FICTIONAL DEMO POLICY. An authorization-denial appeal packet includes the denial notice, evidence of authorization if available, and the relevant service documentation. Missing evidence must be requested; never invent it.
items.source: Fictional ClaimCoach video fixture; not an insurer policy

items.title: Demo authorization appeal template
items.body: FICTIONAL DEMO TEMPLATE. Draft for human review. Use only supplied case facts. Re: claim [Claim number], denial dated [Denial date]. Identify the denied service and CO-197. Request reconsideration based on the supporting documentation that the reviewer will attach. If authorization evidence is absent, mark [Authorization evidence required] rather than assert authorization existed. List enclosures as pending review. End with [Reviewer name and practice contact].
items.source: Fictional ClaimCoach video fixture; not an insurer policy
